# SK9010 — The file does not parse

<!-- Generated from Rules/Rikarin.Skala.Rules.Metadata/rules.json. Do not edit. -->

The file has parse errors, so it is reported and left byte-identical.

| | |
|---|---|
| Category | Tool |
| Default severity | warning |
| Scope | Syntax |
| Needs a compilation | no |
| Fix | no |
| Language version floor | — |
| Since | 0.2 |

## Why

ADR-003, and the single most important safety property in the tool: a file Skala cannot parse is a file Skala does not touch.

## Example

Instead of:

```csharp
class C { void M( }
```

Write:

```csharp
class C { void M() { } }
```

## When it does not fire

None. The check is Roslyn's own error diagnostics.
